# Verb + 返 · *Verb + faan1*

**Meaning:** back; again; return to a previous state · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Verb endings and complements

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Ffaan1-back).

返 after a verb means getting something back or returning to how things were: 攞返 (take back), 還返 (give back), 好返 (get better).

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我想攞返我把遮。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 soeng2 lo2 faan1 ngo5 baa2 ze1. |
| Yale | ngóh séung ló fāan ngóh bá jē. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄙㆦㄥ² ㄌㄛ² ㄈㄚㄣ¹ ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄅㄚ² ㄗㄝ¹. |
| English | I'd like to get my umbrella back. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你幾時還返本書畀我呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 gei2 si4 waan4 faan1 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5 aa3? |
| Yale | néih géi sìh wàahn fāan bún syū béi ngóh a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄍㄝㄧ² ㄙㄧ⁴ ㄨㄚㄣ⁴ ㄈㄚㄣ¹ ㄅㄨㄣ² ㄙㄩ¹ ㄅㄝㄧ² ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄚ³? |
| English | When will you give the book back to me? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我病好返喇。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 beng6 hou2 faan1 laa3. |
| Yale | ngóh behng hóu fāan la. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄅㄝㄥ⁶ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄈㄚㄣ¹ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | I've got better. |
